turns.question: What was our repeat purchase rate from 1 to 10 October 2026: of the customers who bought in that time, what share bought more than once?
turns.answer: The semantic layer has no repeat purchase rate metric (no share of customers who bought more than once within a period); the closest metrics are Repeat customers (distinct customers with a non-cancelled order in the period who have placed two or more orders in all, not only within the period), Active customers and Repeat-customer revenue share. For 1 to 10 October 2026 there were 10 repeat customers among 17 active customers (distinct customers with at least one non-cancelled order). Late: sales.silver is ready only up to 2026-10-03T00:00Z, older than its 36 h deadline.
